question: In June 2020, which of the following international organisations approved a $500 million Strengthening Teaching-Learning and Results for States Program (STARS) to improve the quality and governance of school education in six Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The World Bank** and the Indian government have inked a $500 million agreement to improve the quality and governance of school education in six Indian states through the Strengthening Teaching-Learning and Results for States Programme (STARS).
